title: Yacht Guitar Orchestra
summary: Rubella and Lillith sunbathing on a yacht while a guitar line plays the rail. Three-song hard-cut journey: daylight vine island with guitar orchestra bed, dark island fire with Wallisian bed, night approach to Busan Gwangan Bridge with Korean K-pop bed. No landing.
visualArc: Open ocean lounges + guitar line → vine island horizon → shore cannons + parrots + dolphin leap → hard cut dark: lights in vines + beach fire → hard cut night: Busan Gwangan Bridge RGB + Marine City.
